# Basic — JTGravity

Unformalized claims gathered verbatim from [wiphy.org](https://wiphy.org/) (query: “JT gravity”).

claims.name: ds_jt_gravity_formally_analytic
claims.statement: dS JT gravity is formally an analytic continuation of AdS JT gravity.

claims.name: factorization_problem_differs_between_pure
claims.statement: The factorization problem differs between pure JT gravity and JT gravity with matter.

sources.title: von Neumann algebras in JT gravity

claims.name: paper_computes_holographic_central_charge
claims.statement: The paper computes the holographic central charge \(c_{sDG}\) of sine dilaton gravity in the semiclassical limit and also the central charge \(c_{JT}\) in the JT gravity limit. It finds \(c_{sDG} > c_{JT}\) and interprets this inequality as a consequence of JT gravity's UV completion by sine dilaton gravity.

sources.title: Holographic central charge for sine dilaton gravity

claims.name: gravity_path_integral_formalism_jt
claims.statement: The gravity path integral formalism of JT gravity is revisited.

sources.title: Revisiting the second order formalism of JT gravity

claims.name: nyi_entropies_computed_jt_gravity
claims.statement: Rényi entropies are computed for JT gravity.

sources.title: Real-time gravitational replicas: Low dimensional examples

claims.name: bf_theory_equivalent_jt_gravity
claims.statement: BF theory is equivalent to JT gravity.

sources.title: A holographic description on half planes and wedges for N = 1 SUSY BF theory in 2D

claims.name: propose_alternative_uv_completion_pure
claims.statement: We propose alternative UV completion of pure JT gravity as well as CFT coupled to JT gravity, via a class of deformed 2D CFT.

claims.name: super_jt_gravity_described_particle
claims.statement: The (super)JT gravity can be described by a particle moving on the isometry group satisfying constraints from boundary conditions of (super)JT gravity.

sources.title: Constrained particle on a group: from propagators to correlators

claims.name: class_ii_precisely_reproduces_usual
claims.statement: Class II precisely reproduces the usual JT gravity.

sources.title: Gauge Theory Formulation of Hyperbolic Gravity

claims.name: obtained_model_corresponds_jt_gravity
claims.statement: The obtained model corresponds to 2d JT gravity within symmetric teleparallel gravity.

claims.name: random_geometry_formulation_jt_gravity
claims.statement: The random geometry formulation of JT gravity and the understanding of random critical maps yields the discovery of a new family of deformations of JT gravity.

sources.title: Random Geometry and Quantum Spacetime: From scale-invariant random geometries and asymptotic safety to random hyperbolic surfaces and JT gravity

claims.name: though_jt_gravity_plus_cft
claims.statement: Though JT gravity plus a CFT probably does not define a complete quantum gravity theory, it seems likely that well defined theories could be approximated by JT gravity plus a CFT.

sources.title: Replica Wormholes and the Entropy of Hawking Radiation

claims.name: generalized_jt_gravity_exhibits_black
claims.statement: Generalized JT gravity exhibits a black hole phase transition.

sources.title: Phase Transition in JT Gravity and $T\bar{T}$ Deformation

claims.name: scaling_limit_reduces_model_jt
claims.statement: A scaling limit reduces the model to JT gravity and yields a novel equivariant-localization computation of JT partition functions.

claims.name: one_parameter_deformation_jt_gravity
claims.statement: This one parameter deformation of JT gravity can be rewritten as Liouville gravity.

claims.name: paper_also_identifies_scaling_limit
claims.statement: The paper also identifies a scaling limit in which the chiral-gravity model reduces to JT gravity, giving a new equivariant-localization method for computing JT partition functions.

claims.name: method_applies_jt_gravity_other
claims.statement: The method applies to JT gravity and to other two-dimensional dilaton gravity theories.

sources.title: Microcanonical Action and the Entropy of Hawking Radiation

claims.name: introducing_fluctuation_reduces_gravity_brane
claims.statement: Introducing a fluctuation reduces the gravity on the brane to a JT gravity model.
